name: magic-ui-shimmer-button

frames.best_why: The travelling glint shows at both the top rim and the lower edge, so the shimmer is clearest.

tagline: A band of light travels around the rim of a black pill button.
summary: A black pill-shaped call-to-action with white text whose border is lit by a bright glint that circles the edge continuously; hovering deepens the inner bottom shadow.
appearance: A wide black pill-shaped button with fully rounded ends and a hairline white border, holding the words "Get Started" in plain white. A thin bright crescent of light runs along part of its edge.
behaviour: A small highlight travels around the rim on a slow three-second loop, lighting different stretches of the border as it passes. Hover deepens the inner shadow and a press nudges the button down a pixel.
search_phrases: black pill button with moving light
dark rounded cta with light sweep
use_when: A single primary action should draw the eye on a dark landing page.
avoid_when: Light pages: the black pill and faint white glow are built for dark surfaces.
customise: The label is children; shimmer colour, band width, duration, corner radius and background are props.
weight_why: A couple of layered elements moved by two CSS keyframe animations; no script.

a11y.note: A native button with readable white text, so it works by keyboard; the endless shimmer ignores prefers-reduced-motion.

polish_why: Crisp pill and a smooth travelling glint; the effect stays subtle and the label readable.
title: Shimmer Button
